npc.main.name: DrSallan
npc.main.header: Hello welcome to your own Archives of the past. What can I help you with ?
npc.main.option2: How do I get the Relics ?
npc.main.answer1: This is the Archives of the past. Here we store the most looked for Relics of the past.
npc.main.answer2: Every Relic has it's own way of being obtained. Some are gotten through tasks while others have a higher cost. Check your advancements for some more information!
npc.mod.name: Min the Modder
npc.mod.header: Hi, I'm in charge of the Modding History ! What can I help you with ?
npc.mod.option2: How do I know where to place the modded Relics ?
npc.mod.answer1: I'm Min! I love modding, especially the Minecraft kind! I've played through countless modpacks and even tried making my own once! That... didn't end well...
npc.mod.answer2: Every display case has a little sign. Click it with an empty hand to know what's supposed to be placed on it!
npc.mod.trophy: I completed the collection, what do I get ?
npc.mod.trophy1: Yeah I saw !! Thanks a lot ! Here take this as a token of gratitude and to prove how good you are at modding history!
npc.mod.trophy2: Thanks again for completing the collection !
npc.real.name: Harry the Historian
npc.real.header: Hi, I'm in charge of the Real Life History ! What can I help you with ?
npc.real.option2: How do I know where to place the real life Relics ?
npc.real.answer1: I'm Harry! I've been studying all parts of Real Life History for as long as I have been alive! These relics mean a lot to me!
npc.real.answer2: Every display case has a little sign. Click it with an empty hand to know what's supposed to be placed on it!
npc.real.trophy: I completed the collection, what do I get ?
npc.real.trophy1: Yeah I saw !! Thanks a lot ! Here take this as a token of gratitude. You're almost as good at history as me!
npc.real.trophy2: Thanks again for completing the collection !
npc.old.name: Mark the Miner
npc.old.header: Hi, I'm in charge of the Minecraft History ! What can I help you with ?
npc.old.option2: How do I know where to place the real life Relics ?
npc.old.answer1: I'm Mark. People told me I looked like 'steve'. I didn't see it but I started mining and crafting and never really stopped! I've seen it all so it felt fitting to be leading this collection!
npc.old.answer2: Every display case has a little sign. Click it with an empty hand to know what's supposed to be placed on it!
npc.old.trophy: I completed the collection, what do I get ?
npc.old.trophy1: OMG!! I haven't seen some of these in AGES! Thanks a lot ! Here take this as a thank you!
npc.old.trophy2: Thanks again for completing the collection !
